verdict.rationale: LibreChat's official docs include a dedicated Docker Compose guide, which they recommend for most scenarios, plus a Kubernetes/Helm chart guide and an npm path. A remote-deployment overview points to detailed hosting guides, and one community user reports installation was easy. Missing for 10: an explicitly evidenced small-VPS guide (only implied by the remote-deployment overview), any Raspberry Pi/ARM guide, and evidence that each guide is actively maintained.
